A technician sets up a radiation detector in a university laboratory, for use in some experiments.
Even before the radioactive source for the experiment is brought into the laboratory, the detector
registers a low count rate.

content.html: Suggest what causes this count rate.
content.text: Suggest what causes this count rate.

content.html: A radioactive source that emits α-particles is placed on the laboratory bench and the source is gradually moved closer to the detector.
content.text: A radioactive source that emits α-particles is placed on the laboratory bench and the source is gradually moved closer to the detector.

content.html: At first, the detector continues to register a low count rate sometimes slightly less than the count rate registered without the source. The count rate suddenly increases to a very high value when the source is very close to the detector.
content.text: At first, the detector continues to register a low count rate sometimes slightly less than the count rate registered without the source. The count rate suddenly increases to a very high value when the source is very close to the detector.

content.html: Explain these changes in the count rate.
